intro: Morocco has one of Africa's most varied economies, with cars, phosphates, farming and tourism.

chapters.title: Industry
text: Morocco holds most of the world's phosphate reserves, used for fertiliser. Car factories near Tangier and Kenitra make it Africa's biggest car producer.
Noor Ouarzazate is one of the world's largest solar power complexes.

chapters.title: Tourism
text: Over 17 million tourists visited in 2024, drawn by Marrakesh, Fez and the desert.

keyTerms.meaning: A mineral used to make fertiliser.
